Future of Work
With Artificial Intelligence radically reshaping industries, the gig economy rising, and traditional linear careers shifting, the definition of professional readiness has completely changed. We want to know how well your current education is matching today's fast-paced job market, how you are adopting technology, and what you need to feel financially secure. Please be completely honest and choose what best applies to your reality; your answers will tell employers and universities exactly how they need to adapt.
